Get started

A wallpaper.
Your colors.

Set a Ghostty wallpaper, generate matching terminal colors, and save looks you can switch between.

Install Ghostty Wall View on GitHub
Linux x86_64 stablemacOS experimentalMIT licensed

Try the bundled wallpaper#

Terminal
ghostty-wall init
ghostty-wall apply welcome
ghostty-wall create

After installing, try Welcome, then generate a wallpaper or choose your PNG/JPEG. Save and choose Use now to apply it. If Ghostty does not change, reload its configuration manually.

Browse your saved looks#

Run ghostty-wall, select a profile to preview it, then choose Use to apply it. Browser and editor samples are internal previews, not live Ghostty reload.
